description: TU Delft publishes the Egg Model as a standard synthetic benchmark for reservoir simulation and optimisation. It contains 101 three-dimensional realisations of a channelised oil reservoir with eight water injectors and four production wells. The deposit includes simulator input files for Dynamo/Mores, Eclipse, AD-GPRS and MRST, which the authors report testing for comparable outputs. 4TU.ResearchData supplies a public ZIP archive containing binary and plain-text material. Its spatial coverage is a synthetic reservoir with no real-world location. The 2013 benchmark represents a synthetic reservoir, not a measured Dutch field or a historical operating period. Numerical grid dimensions and production schedules were not checked inside the archive. Access is free under the repository’s 4TU General Terms of Use; this is not an assertion that a standard open-source software licence applies to every simulator. The ensemble can support history-matching, uncertainty and water-flood optimisation experiments. A limitation is that its simplified geometry does not establish performance in heterogeneous operational reservoirs. It complements reservoir simulation engines by supplying a common input case with multiple geological realisations.
